name: Zomba (contacted by Jeff Blue before signing)

podcast.title: A&R Executive's Role
podcast.body: A VP of A&R at Zomba Music heard about Chester Bennington and contacted him to audition for the band Zero. This executive, later named Jeff, moved to Warner Brothers Records and was instrumental in Linkin Park signing their deal. "A VP of ANR at Zomba Music had heard about Chester."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Contact with Zero
podcast.body: Jeff Blue, then a vice president at Zomba, played a crucial role in connecting Zero with Chester Bennington in March 1999, which ultimately led to the formation of Linkin Park. "C-Zero had made contact with Jeff Blue, a vice president at a label called Zumba."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
